I'm legitimately surprised by how much I liked this, particularly the ending. This is definitely a case where the magic of an anomaly operates as a metaphor for a real-world issue and allows for an interesting, different perspective.

I typically respond poorly to anything with an overt political message; it's a hard sell for me because it always sounds so preachy. I don't know by what alchemy you've managed to make this instance work for me, but you did.

You know, Warner, the reason people listen to Greenfield is because he actually does what he says he wants to. […] If you had half the guts he does, he wouldn't have ever gotten this far.

No wonder you lost the election.

Whatever subtlety the main article has in its political statement, you've clearly discarded by this point.

That's not a complaint — it's actually pretty refreshing. I just happen to think it's funny as well. Solid +1.
